revision_notes: Not supported as stated. No Côte d'Ivoire-specific GSMA/Statista smartphone percentage was located. Recalculated to 0 (Unknown) rather than guess; recommend a licensed GSMA Intelligence country pull to establish the true figure.

revision_notes: Genuinely conflicting evidence — HUMAN REVIEW. Côte d'Ivoire's own economic ministry portal gives an exact 2023 breakdown (hydro 23.98% + solar 0.18% = ~24.2% of gross generation, calculated from stated GWh figures), placing the country just under the 25% threshold (band 2, 10-24%). However, the IEA's official country page states renewables are a 25.521% share of power generation (year not stated in the snippet, likely 2023), which is just inside band 3 (25-49%), consistent with the original code. Given two authoritative sources place the figure just below 25% and one just above, this is a genuine boundary case; retained the original Value Code 3 rather than assert a change, but flag for a human check of the IEA/national-portal discrepancy and the exact year each reflects.
